description: Cheap-insurance V1/V2 compile-check for 3 files shipped this session that were never compiled on real hardware: F0605B (06-05's restored QCMDEXC demo, src/qrpglesrc/f0605bs.rpgle - CALLed too, since it's a plain RPG program with no WORKSTN device, and its CHGDTAARA(*LDA) effect is cheaply verifiable via DSPDTAARA), and D0702A/F0702B (07-02's advanced/optional 'JUCLST4 with JUCSRV' exercise, src/qddssrc/d0702s.dspf + src/qrpglesrc/f0702bs.rpgle - compile-check only, NOT CALLed, since F0702B is a WORKSTN/EXFMT program and CALLing it over non-interactive SSH would hang, the same established limitation as every other screen program in this repo). Rebuilds JUCSRV (*SRVPGM, final EXPORT(*SRCFILE) state) and ensures JUCSRVBD (*BNDDIR) exist first, using the exact proven recipe from part07-0203-srvpgm/part07-03-signature (both already CONFIRMED SUCCESS), since F0702B's CRTBNDRPG needs JUCSRVBD to resolve getCustName at bind time and the target library's current state from earlier connections cannot be assumed. Does not touch ZAIKOM/SHOHIM - no TXRESET needed.

steps.label: CPJUCSSRV
steps.cmd: CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/JUCSRV) MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCFILE(&LIB/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(JUCSRV) ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPJUCSBD
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/JUCSRVBD) OBJTYPE(*BNDDIR)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTBNDDIR BNDDIR(&LIB/JUCSRVBD))
ADDBNDDIRE BNDDIR(&LIB/JUCSRVBD) OBJ((*LIBL/JUCSRV *SRVPGM))
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
